title: What I Learned From DeepSeek's Harness

direction.name: Graphite Ledger Editorial
direction.visual_spine: Warm porcelain paper field, ink graphite structure, raised paper ledger surfaces, serif display claims, neutral sans explanation, monospace as the motif carrier; one dominant cyan accent (model-visible / what you keep), muted coral as tension punctuation; no green, no dark default canvas (one ink punctuation page), no cards-as-UI. The film behaves like the append-only session log it describes: chapters append as mono ledger lines and nothing is erased.
